profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Wendy’s Company
profile.summary:
Experienced Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Flutter, BLoC, C#, Written Communication, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and FastAPI/Python. Strong operations professional with a Simulation and Game Design - Programming A.A.S. focused in Game and Interactive Media Design from Wake Technical Community College. 

I'm also an experienced Manual Software tester with a Certification of completion for Java Automation testing with Selenium, Maven, TestNG, and Jenkins.
